description: social.md §4.1–§4.8 and §4.10–§4.12: authorities and ranks, forum-scope assertions and their authorisation (rank, role, until, CID binding), resolution of every dimension, keeps against bans, restrictions and locks, lapse and adoption, fail closed, the mod log and mod queue. Author tier (§4.9) vectors are a separate file. input: {fold: FoldInput}. expected: the modfold projection fields listed (testdata/vectors/README.md, social section). Generated by testdata/vectors/social-ref/gen_social.py from the reference model (testdata/vectors/social-ref/lessdugin_ref); do not edit by hand.

vectors.name: owner-hide-beats-moderator-keep
vectors.note: rank 3 beats rank 1: the owner's hide wins over the moderator's keep (§4.4: higher rank wins)

vectors.name: owner-keep-beats-moderator-hide
vectors.note: the owner's keep (hidden = false, CID-bound to the current version) resolves hidden = false at rank 3

vectors.name: same-rank-hide-and-keep-gives-hide
vectors.note: two moderators (rank 1) disagree: the safest value (hidden = true) wins; a restore cannot beat an equal-rank hide (two-person rule)

vectors.name: equal-rank-winner-is-the-smallest-uri
vectors.note: both rank-1 records hide; the winner is the smallest uri (mike's DID sorts before mona's) and the shown reason comes from the winner

vectors.name: reason-shown-only-with-showReason
vectors.note: Removed carries the winner's reason only if its showReason (default true) holds; a hide without reason shows null

vectors.name: spam-is-hidden-and-spam
vectors.note: #hide asserts spam = hidden ∧ spam: a hide with spam asserts spam = true; a keep with spam = true asserts spam = false; at a higher rank a plain hide resolves spam = false. Removed.spam is effective(x, spam) (NOTES.md)

vectors.name: removed-spam-is-the-resolved-spam
vectors.note: two rank-1 hides disagree on spam: hidden resolves to true with winner mike's record (the smallest uri), whose own spam is false; spam resolves to true (the safest value; winner mona's record). Removed takes rank, actor and reason from the winner of hidden, and spam = effective(x, spam) = true, the value that voids opinions (O5) (NOTES.md 8)

vectors.name: rank-rule
vectors.note: X = owner ∨ X = subjectAuthor(T) ∨ rank(X) > subjectRank(T): a moderator cannot act on an admin's, another moderator's or the owner's post, but can on her own; an admin can on a moderator's; the owner on anyone

vectors.name: moderator-cannot-curate
vectors.note: #tier curated needs an owner or admin; a moderator may set personal or frontpage

vectors.name: demoted-admin-curation-stops
vectors.note: adam is now listed as a moderator: the role is re-evaluated at once, so his curation is unauthorised (the tier falls back to defaultTier) while his frontpage tier still counts

vectors.name: lapse-on-removal-from-the-declaration
vectors.note: mona is no longer in decl.moderators: her assertions have no forum-tier effect at once and the mod log shows them as lapsed

vectors.name: adopt-restores-lapsed-assertions
vectors.note: mod adopt re-issued mona's assertions under adam (same rkey in adam's repo, adopts pointing at the originals): the copies count at adam's rank; the originals stay lapsed

vectors.name: adopted-copy-counts-on-its-own-merits
vectors.note: adam (former admin) is gone; copies of his assertions count only on their own merits: mona (moderator) cannot curate (unauthorised); mike's copy of a keep carries the pre-edit subjectCid (stale); mona's copy has its own until in the past (expired). adopts is informational

vectors.name: non-authority-assertion-is-lapsed
vectors.note: a forum-scope assertion by an actor outside A has no effect; the fold cannot tell a former moderator from a user who never was one, so the mod log shows lapsed (NOTES.md)

vectors.name: until-expiry
vectors.note: an assertion counts while µs(until) > now: until = now + 1 µs counts; until = now and earlier have expired

vectors.name: ban-and-restrict-until
vectors.note: an expired ban has no effect (alice is not in B); a restriction with a future until still hides

vectors.name: pin-tier-and-keep-stop-after-an-edit
vectors.note: alice edited the post after the pin, the curation and the keep: their subjectCid names the previous version, so all three are stale (excluded from resolve; mod-queue items); the pin drops, the tier falls back to defaultTier and the lower-rank hide now governs. The hide is negative, so its (old) subjectCid does not matter

vectors.name: reasserted-on-the-new-version
vectors.note: assertions whose subjectCid is the current CID count; the keep still names the old version and stays stale

vectors.name: negative-assertions-ignore-subjectCid
vectors.note: negative assertions (tier personal, pinned = false, hide) count whatever their subjectCid, even without one; on a DID subject subjectCid is ignored

vectors.name: positive-assertion-on-a-subject-not-in-records-never-counts
vectors.note: the subject post is not in records (not yet synced, or deleted): positive assertions on it never count; they are shown as stale but are not mod-queue items (nothing was edited)

vectors.name: keep-at-equal-rank-beats-ban
vectors.note: keepRank(p1) = 1 ≥ banRank(alice) = 1: the kept post stays visible; her other post is Hidden(Banned)

vectors.name: keep-at-lower-rank-loses-to-ban
vectors.note: banRank(alice) = 2: a moderator's keep (1) does not exempt p1; the owner's keep (3) exempts p2

vectors.name: ban-hides-every-item-kind
vectors.note: every item the banned user authored in F (post, comment, sequence, wikiRevision) is Hidden(Banned), whatever its claimed time

vectors.name: banning-a-lower-ranked-authority
vectors.note: an admin may ban a moderator: her content is Hidden(Banned) and she leaves S, but she keeps her authority (only the declaration confers it), so her hide still counts

vectors.name: restrict-hides-retroactively
vectors.note: a #restrict{post} written on day 10 hides alice's posts claimed before and after it (rule 4b: time is self-asserted, so it is retroactive); her comment is not restricted

vectors.name: restrict-overridden-by-a-keep-at-higher-or-equal-rank
vectors.note: keepRank(item) ≥ restrictRank(author) exempts the item: adam's keep (2) and mike's keep (1) exempt alice's posts from mona's restriction (1); mona's keep (1) does not exempt bob's comment from adam's restriction (2)

vectors.name: restrict-capabilities-map-to-collections
vectors.note: comment, sequence and wiki hide those collections (cap(x)); post is not restricted here; the unknown capability 'dance' is ignored and the duplicate collapses (MA8); vote, react and tag hide nothing (they act on opinions, L3/L5)

vectors.name: restrict-equal-rank-sets-unite
vectors.note: two rank-1 restrictions unite their sets; the winner of the set dimension is the smallest uri among all rank-1 records (mike's)

vectors.name: empty-restrict-at-higher-rank-lifts
vectors.note: a #restrict states the complete set: adam's empty record (rank 2) resolves restrict = ∅ and nullify = false, lifting mona's restriction and nullification of alice; at equal rank an empty set only unites, so mike's empty record does not lift mona's restriction of bob

vectors.name: tag-subject-by-a-moderator
vectors.note: tag: subjects have rank 0, so every authority (here moderators) can assert tag.removed and tag.head; a user's #tag is lapsed

vectors.name: tag-head-conflict-at-equal-rank
vectors.note: tag.head is unordered: two different rank-1 heads give Default (no override) and a mod-queue conflict item; tag.removed = false still resolves. Both records show effective in the mod log through tag.removed (NOTES.md)

vectors.name: tag-head-higher-rank-settles-a-conflict
vectors.note: the admin's head (rank 2) resolves tag.head; the moderators' records are overridden

vectors.name: tag-head-equal-values-agree
vectors.note: equal heads at equal rank resolve (winner: smallest uri); tag.removed resolves to the safest value, true, from mike's record

vectors.name: tag-head-bound-by-its-cid
vectors.note: #tag.head counts only if records[head.uri] exists with CID head.cid: mona's head names r1 with r2's CID (stale, a mod-queue item), mike's names a revision that is not in records (stale, no queue item); their tag.removed = false still counts

vectors.name: lock-hides-comments-outside-allowed
vectors.note: a forum-tier lock (rank 1) hides every comment of the thread not in allowed, except those by an authority (mike) and those kept at rank ≥ lockRank (adam's keep, rank 2; mike's keep, rank 1); the post's author is not exempt from a forum-tier lock

vectors.name: lock-allow-lists-intersect-at-equal-rank
vectors.note: allowed(p) is the intersection of the allow-lists of the rank-r records that lock

vectors.name: lock-allowed-entries-outside-the-thread-ignored
vectors.note: MA9: an allowed entry whose rkey is not {fk}-{threadTid(p)}-… (a comment of another thread) is ignored; an entry in p's key range is kept even if that comment is not in records

vectors.name: unlock-needs-a-higher-rank
vectors.note: a higher rank's #lock{locked: false} unlocks p1; an equal-rank unlock loses to the lock (the safe value), and allowed comes only from the rank-r records that lock

vectors.name: forum-uri-lock-has-no-effect
vectors.note: a #lock whose subject is the forum uri is reserved (P2, MA9): valid, without effect for any actor, shown as reserved/unknown

vectors.name: pins
vectors.note: pin[s] is ordered false < true, so an equal-rank unpin beats a pin (p1) and so does a higher one (p2); thread pins apply to comments and forum pins to posts and sequences

vectors.name: default-tier-frontpage
vectors.note: decl.defaultTier = frontpage is the tier of a post with no resolved #tier

vectors.name: unknown-action-scope-or-value-has-no-effect
vectors.note: MA7: an unknown action $type (in or outside NS), an unknown scope, or an unknown #access.level, #tier.tier or #pin.scope makes the record valid but without effect (reserved/unknown)

vectors.name: reserved-tid-key-is-ignored
vectors.note: MA2: a modAction key of the form ^FK-TID$ is reserved for P2 list actions; such a record is not invalid but has no effect in v1

vectors.name: mod-log-status-precedence
vectors.note: each record fails several §4.3 conditions; the status is the first that applies, in the order reserved/unknown, lapsed, unauthorised, expired, stale (README, social section): zed (no authority) with an expired until is lapsed; mona's expired hide of the admin's post is unauthorised (rank); mona's expired keep with a wrong subjectCid is expired; her curation with a wrong subjectCid is unauthorised (role); zed's expired record under a reserved ^FK-TID$ key is reserved/unknown; mike's keep with a wrong subjectCid is stale, and the only mod-queue item because its subject is in records

vectors.name: invalid-modactions-are-excluded
vectors.note: invalid records have no effect and are not in the mod log (raw view only): a positive pin without subjectCid (MA5), a #hide whose subject is a DID (MA4), and an author-scope #tier (MA6)

vectors.name: mod-log-order-edits-and-removals
vectors.note: order (time desc, uri asc) with time = µs(updatedAt) ?? µs(createdAt) for a modAction and µs(createdAt) for a revision; revisions of modActions appear as edited (op update) or removed (op delete, the modAction itself is gone); a post's revision is not a mod-log entry

vectors.name: degraded-view
vectors.note: mona's repo is Unavailable, so the view is degraded: items by authors outside S are Hidden(ModerationUnavailable); bob (granted) and mona (an authority) are in S; mona's cached hide still applies

vectors.name: stale-authority-does-not-degrade
vectors.note: a Stale authority repo contributes its cached assertions and does not degrade the view; an Unavailable non-authority repo does not either

vectors.name: authority-missing-from-repoStatus-degrades
vectors.note: a DID missing from repoStatus is Unavailable: mike has no entry, so the view is degraded
